title: Undo a buy before confirming, and rename inside the room
problem: Informal feedback (REP-045): no undo after tapping a fruit before the buy is confirmed; the game name cannot be edited in the room. By code, tapping a fruit sends the buy at once (useGameController.ts), so an undo needs a new legal action and, online, a server-checked change.
scope: Step 1, no code: read useGameController.ts, turn.ts and server/room.ts, and propose how undo should work (undo the last buy only, until the turn ends) and what rename in a room needs; the owner approves the design
Step 2: implement with tests for illegal, duplicate and stale actions, and reconnect (the online-authority rules in CLAUDE.md)
Undo must not reveal hidden information or let a player gain by undoing

acceptance.text: Design note approved by the owner before any code
Online tests pass for undo, duplicates, stale actions and reconnect; the leak check stays at 0
